name: stroke
description: Stroke CDS — an educational clinical-decision-support demo for acute stroke workflows across telestroke, inpatient, and clinic settings. Educational use only.

paragraphs: Stroke is a lean, deterministic browser workspace. Encounter opens immediately; the secondary tabs are Protocols, Trials, Evidence and Calculators.

The public build is a synthetic demo. Do not enter PHI, identifiers, real encounter details or confidential information. It is not an approved clinical tool, medical advice, or an institutional system.

Sixteen source-linked worksheets and descriptor aids are available in Calculators and score live once every required item is answered (an explicit attestation is required only to write a score into Encounter): ABCD², CHA₂DS₂-VASc, HAS-BLED, RoPE, PASCAL, PHASES, mRS, Hunt–Hess, WFNS, regional ASPECTS/pc-ASPECTS, PHQ-2, STOP-BANG, modified Fisher, mTICI and NASCET. Shared measurements come from Encounter; ABCD² separately records the first blood pressure after the TIA, independently of current treatment-review BP; reviewed applications and screening exports invalidate after source edits.…
features: Case bar (every tab). Once anything is entered, a pinned bar shows the diagnosis, LKW/discovery elapsed time (h:mm) with the 4.5 h and 24 h references, NIHSS (or GCS for hemorrhage), BP, glucose, weight, thrombolytic…
Global search. Ctrl/⌘ K or / searches navigation, protocol sections, the bedside quick reference, calculators, Evidence topics and study summaries, and external references.

Encounter. Four steps: context/baseline/timing, examination/imaging, safety and decision review, documented actions/monitoring/handoff. Phone-consult entries come first (diagnosis, age, sex, weight with a kg|lb toggle,…

Notes. Telephone Pulsara summaries, full video Epic notes and optional follow-up, progress, discharge, transfer, team handoff and procedure formats share one pipeline. Every exported time is local wall time (a UTC…

Protocols. A bedside quick reference (dose by weight, BP targets by phase, anticoagulant reversal, post-thrombolysis sICH, angioedema, malignant edema, supportive care) sits above the protected ischemic and ICH example…
